specification.method: Source-built reference sorts only five ranks and enumerates all 21 five-card subsets for every seven-card hand, independent of production direct seven-card classification. Validate every five-card category/kicker tuple first. Keep binary dump/raw counts/reports outside checkout; publish textual provenance/results only. Existing production three-pair preparation limits remain mandatory. Runtime is validation duration, not a speed benchmark or RSS measurement.
specification.scope: Fixed three-pair physical count reference; no new solver API, changed enumeration caps, later-street decisions, range-wide equilibrium claim, binary distribution or copied third-party code.
